previous_land_use: Area history of Jawcraig Colliery, opencast fireclay working (Wester Jawcraig) and Jawcraig brickworks; current land is largely farmland and rough grazing on the Slamannan Plateau. Not tied to any specific development parcel.
land_notes: Coordinates estimated as c.3 km north of Slamannan per the Gazetteer for Scotland description (Nominatim has no entry for Jawcraig); treat as settlement-level only.
